tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Open Brain memories by meaning. Use this read-only compatibility tool when ChatGPT needs search/fetch-style access to stored thoughts.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one Open Brain thought by ID after using search. Use this read-only compatibility tool to retrieve the full text and metadata for citation.

tools.name: search_thoughts
tools.description: Search captured thoughts by meaning. Use this when the user asks about a topic, person, or idea they've previously captured.

tools.name: list_thoughts
tools.description: List recently captured thoughts with optional filters by type, topic, person, or time range.

tools.name: thought_stats
tools.description: Get a summary of all captured thoughts: totals, types, top topics, and people.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
